I replied in #coastal-team, but I didn't give you the Saltmarsh discount figure.

Discount terms are finance figures. They go only to June Osei-Lark (deal desk), Anselm Grieve (CFO) and the account owner, Sofia Marchetti. For the renewal brief, ask June or Sofia for the current number. I can still help with the non-financial parts of the brief, such as seat counts, renewal dates, open tickets and contacts.
